full.description: This is a light micrograph of renal tissue showing the cortex with glomeruli and renal tubules. The section demonstrates features characteristic of acute tubular injury or acute tubular necrosis, including loss of brush borders and vacuolization of tubular epithelial cells. There is also mild interstitial inflammation and congestion present in the peritubular capillaries. The glomeruli appear relatively well-preserved compared to the tubular changes.

random.description: This image is a photomicrograph of renal tissue showing sections of renal tubules and glomeruli. There is evidence of acute tubular injury with flattening of tubular epithelium and interstitial edema. Inflammatory cell infiltration is visible within the renal interstitium. These histological findings are characteristic of acute tubulointerstitial nephritis.
